exposure: Telemonitoring of blood glucose using myDiabby HealthcareⓇ app
Classical blood glucose monitoring by diary
classical glycaemic blood monitoring by diary
outcome: Composite maternal, fetal, and neonatal complications
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus telemonitoring using an app was non-inferior to classical blood glucose monitoring by diary in terms of maternal, fetal, and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: The study found that rates of cesarean section were lower in the telemonitoring group compared to the control group (20% vs. 23%), but the difference was not statistically significant.
